numeric_fields_check: All 54 rows have empty last_stable_flow_cm_s and extinction_flow_cm_s; no pot or fan value was entered as cm/s; no Air display value is tied by its cell to a limit instant.

corrected.statement: Number of concurrent rod tests performed (not analysed): 24. Figure 4 plots a subset of points. The same sentence repeats on p.2 and p.9.

Authors' hedged inference ('so it seems that'): once blown downstream, the flame appeared unable to propagate upstream and re-establish the stagnation region at the O2 levels tested, 16.1% O2 and lower. The paper reports one success, where the blowoff may have been incomplete.

answers.P5_P13a: Quench extinctions in the literal sense ('down to ext' / '0 ext'), but not incremental quench-limit points: the Summary Report shows the flame stable at every finite setting down to pot 0.28 / 0.26 and out only when the fan was set to 0. Count them as quench events with a 'fan-to-zero, bracket only' flag; keep them out of any limit fit unless the flag is shown. P4 and P6 ('off') are the same physical action and are labelled unclear because their cells do not say what went off.
answers.summary_report_column: No row used it. Of the 29 unclear rows (before the four MODIFY rows), the observation column gives a clear outcome for 21: quench 13 (O13a, O15a, O15b, P3a, P12, P14, P16, P17, P18, P19, P20, P23, P24), blowoff 4 (O5a, O10, O17, O18), no limit 4 (O1, P2, P4, P6); 7 stay unclear (O2, O3b, O13b, O20, O21, P3b, P15); O3a is an extinction the authors call 'probably overshot'. With the four MODIFY rows (O5b, O16, P21a, P21b) now unclear, the column would also give an outcome for all four.
answers.24_tests: Supported as a count match, not row-by-row identity: 24 pre-2016 Olson rows (O1-O19 with a/b, table rows 47-70), 22 clear and 2 black (O11, O14), matching NTRS p.1 and p.2; sample numbers reproduce p.3's 17 clear (11 x 1/4, 4 x 3/8, 2 x 1/2). The 24 includes O12 (no ignition) and O5b/O16 (no sustained flame), so it is not 24 flammability points. Table A.3 marks P16 and P19 'Concurrent'. O20-O22 (2016) reburn samples 204, 219m, 220m; P25 reburns 217m.
answers.O4: Supported with one caveat: O4 (row 51, 3/8 in clear rod, calibrated initial/final O2 14.8 / 13.6) is the lowest final O2 among ignited rows (O12 has 13.5 but did not ignite). Summary Report p.77 names the lowest O2 quenching test (14.8 -> 13.6, r = 0.476 cm). NTRS p.7 does not name the test, so it is a match by value and rod size, not a stated identity. The value is the calibrated final O2; the uncalibrated Table A.5 value is 12.7.

could_not_check: NTRS Figure 4 could not be rendered, so rows cannot be mapped to plotted points; Summary Report read only through the text dump; fan calibration spreadsheets not opened; whether 'out' in O6 marks .305 or .275 unsettled; P17 233 > 122, P22a/P22b final O2 (0.6 and 39.1) and decimal Air display values are unresolved anomalies.
